title: Analytical Reporting reference solution
answer: WITH monthly AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY date_trunc('month', order_date)), prior AS (SELECT month, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prior_revenue FROM monthly) SELECT month, revenue, prior_revenue, revenue - prior_revenue AS absolute_growth FROM prior ORDER BY month;
explanation: The result shows monthly revenue and absolute change from the prior observed month; percentage change needs a zero-safe denominator. Review the query against the lab data and explain why the chosen joins, filters, aggregation grain, ordering, or transaction boundary is correct.
